name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-sharepoint-page-governance-review
title: SharePoint Page Governance Review
shortDescription: A bounded, read-only heuristic review of configured SharePoint page sources.
longDescription: Reviews configured SharePoint page sources with explicit bounds, safe paths, and readable governance heuristics. It never changes SharePoint content or settings.

references.description: Official Microsoft guidance for building an SPFx client-side web part.
